decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The works of demolition hereby approved shall not be commenced before contract(s) for the carrying out of the works of redevelopment of the site, including the works contract, have been made and evidence of such contract(s) has been submitted to and accepted in writing by the Council as a local planning authority, and planning permission has been granted for the redevelopment for which the contract(s) provide.
description: Demolition of existing garages and the erection of 2 semi detached, 4 bedroomed houses and 1 terraced, 4 bedroomed house.  Demolition of existing extension and the erection of 2 storey side extension and single storey rear extension to no. 46, removal of existing external staircase and the creation of a new vehicular entrance to no. 48.
